newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - News Corp cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - News Corp cut.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities said it downgraded News Corp Ltd to hold from trading buy.

-- NatWest expressed concern over rising medium-term risks and said it continues to expect fiscal 1998 earnings per share to decline from 1997, "an important negative given the 'show me' mindset of many investors."
-- "We view News Corp's long-term growth appeal as stronger than ever but now struggle to identify the near-term investment positives that will drive the stock price," NatWest said.
-- News Corp's NYSE-listed ADRs were off 1/4 to 21-1/2.
